title: Optimize: config versioning store tables/models + API scaffold (behind flag)
author: Benji Okafor
body:
Title: Optimize: config versioning store tables/models + API scaffold (behind flag)

Context
We’re starting the “Safe apply + rollback mechanism” work by laying down the version store (schema + models) and a thin API scaffold that is safe to land early. This PR intentionally does NOT change the runtime behavior or config propagation paths. Everything is guarded by a feature flag so we can deploy the storage and wire up later workflows (diff/preview, safe-apply, rollback) incrementally.

What’s in this PR
- DB schema (new tables) for immutable Optimize config versions + scope keys.
  - optimize_config_versions: immutable version records with content-addressed payload hash
  - optimize_config_version_scopes: normalized scope keys (customer/deployment/region/route/model) used for listing/filtering
  - optimize_config_version_current: pointer table for “current version id” per scope (updated by apply/rollback later; in this PR it is only written in tests)
- Backend models + repository layer
  - CreateVersion(scope, payload, metadata) writes a new immutable record
  - ListVersions(scope, pagination) returns versions newest-first
  - GetVersion(version_id) fetches record + metadata
  - All writes require the feature flag optimize.configVersioning.enabled to be true; otherwise repository methods return a typed “FeatureDisabled” error
- API scaffold (v1)
  - GET /v1/optimize/config/versions (scaffold; returns empty list unless flag enabled and store wired)
  - GET /v1/optimize/config/versions/{id}
  - NOTE: Apply/Rollback endpoints are intentionally not included yet (ENG-4823) to avoid implying semantics before locking/idempotency/audit events land.
- Unit tests
  - Migration smoke test: tables exist + basic constraints
  - Repository tests: create + list + get; verifies payload_hash determinism and that created versions are immutable
  - API handler tests: flag off -> 404/feature-disabled mapping; flag on -> 200 responses with expected shape
- Feature flag wiring
  - Added optimize.configVersioning.enabled (default: false) with env override
  - Wired into control-plane service startup and request handlers

Schema notes / semantics (early, but important)
- Versions are immutable: updates are prohibited (no UPDATE paths in code; DB-level constraint via trigger that rejects updates to payload/payload_hash columns).
- Version identity
  - version_id is a ULID generated at write time
  - payload_hash is SHA-256 over canonicalized JSON payload (canonicalization helper included; see follow-ups for diff service)
- Scope model
  - scope_key is a stable string (e.g. tenant:{tenant_id}|deploy:{deployment_id}|region:{region}|route:{route_id}|model:{model_id})
  - scope_key is indexed for list operations
- Metadata
  - author, source, reason, and links are stored as columns (nullable in this first pass; later PR will tighten requirements for apply/rollback)
  - request_id stored for correlating with audit events later (ENG-4826/ENG-4830)

Out of scope / follow-ups
- Backfill of current live config into v0 (ENG-4821 follow-up; we want to coordinate with migrations rollout and ensure no accidental “version churn”)
- Diff generation / preview payload (ENG-4822)
- Apply / rollback semantics, idempotency keys, locks/leases, propagation status (ENG-4823, ENG-4827)
- RBAC checks and audit log emission for mutation endpoints (ENG-4830 + audit event spec)

Operational / rollout
- Safe to ship with flag disabled.
- Migrations are additive and do not affect existing Optimize config read paths.
- No data retention policies enforced yet; we will add retention + pruning only after we have audit/compliance requirements finalized.

Testing
- Unit tests added for repository and handlers
- Ran locally: make test control-plane, make lint

Screenshots
- N/A (no Console changes)

Checklist
- [x] Add migrations
- [x] Add repository layer with typed errors
- [x] Add basic API scaffold behind feature flag
- [x] Unit tests
- [x] No runtime behavior change

Commits (summary)
1) db/migrations: add optimize config versioning tables
2) control-plane: add optimize config version store + models
3) api: scaffold version listing/get endpoints
4) tests: repo + handler coverage
5) config: feature flag + docs for local enablement

Changed areas (high level)
- services/control-plane/optimize/versioning/*
- services/control-plane/api/handlers/optimize_config_versions*
- db/migrations/2025_01_14_*
- pkg/featureflags/*
- services/control-plane/tests/*

Selected snippets
- Canonicalization helper used for payload hashing:
  - CanonicalJSON(v any) -> stable key order + no insignificant whitespace
  - payload_hash = sha256(CanonicalJSON(payload))
- Update prevention trigger (Postgres): rejects UPDATE on optimize_config_versions.payload and payload_hash

Review discussion (highlights)
- Chloe Martin: Asked to confirm pagination contract now to avoid breaking Console later. Benji: Kept response shape stable (items + next_page_token), but left token opaque; will document in ENG-4822.
- Michael Nguyen: Requested migration naming + down-migration behavior alignment with our standards. Benji: Updated to include explicit down migration and added migration smoke test.
- Kaitlyn Nguyen: Flag behavior: prefer 404 instead of 403 when feature is disabled to avoid leaking endpoint availability. Benji: Handler maps FeatureDisabled -> 404 for now; once RBAC is enforced we’ll revisit status codes.
- Fiona McCarthy: Immutability needs to be defensible for audit/compliance. Benji: Added DB trigger to prevent payload mutation; also added created_at and created_by columns (even if nullable in this PR) and ensured no UPDATE paths exist in code.
- Ethan Park: Noted we should store request_id for later audit correlation. Benji: Added request_id column and plumbed through repository API.

Approvals
- Chloe Martin: Approved after pagination + flag behavior updates
- Michael Nguyen: Approved after migration tweaks
- Kaitlyn Nguyen: Approved
- Fiona McCarthy: Approved with note to tighten required metadata before GA

CI
- build (control-plane): PASS
- unit tests (control-plane): PASS
- lint: PASS
- migrations check: PASS

Merge
- Merged via squash into main on 2025-01-17.

Release notes
- Internal: Adds initial Optimize config versioning schema and API scaffold behind optimize.configVersioning.enabled (default off). No behavior change when disabled.
